study.title: OEDRO AI Research for Drivers
study.goal: Test whether a controlled-autonomy AI interviewer can understand vehicle-lighting experiences, repair conversation breakdowns, and preserve auditable evidence without work-light-specific runtime code.
decisionQuestions: Which real use situations and visibility problems deserve further product research?
Which concept, installation, or price concerns need stronger evidence?

audience.description: Synthetic adult vehicle-owner personas used only for local acceptance testing.
eligibility: Can describe a real lighting situation

claims.text: The synthetic concept includes example size and price tiers from 7–8 inches at $129.99 to 48–52 inches at $499.99.
claims.source: Synthetic research configuration fixture; sample concepts and price tiers for internal testing.

en.title: Review how this synthetic test uses your answers
en.intro: This optional screen is dormant unless a specific project explicitly enables it.
items: Written answers are stored in the local test database and processed by the configured AI provider.
Do not enter names, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses, or other contact details.
en.checkbox: I understand and want to start this synthetic study.

dataPolicy.providerDisclosure: Answers are processed by a configured third-party AI provider for interview understanding, controlled follow-up, and evidence extraction.

fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer as stated or cautiously normalized
Vehicle model as stated or kept as a candidate
The purpose of ordinary after-dark vehicle use, as stated. Keep trip purpose separate from road type, available light, and weather; do not infer one from another.

Non-identifying context of the most recent after-dark use. Preserve stated road type, available light, or weather as separate facts; do not infer any from another. For a driver who only says on the road, clarify road type only if needed. For stationary use, ask about the activity or work surface instead. Never collect an address or demand all context dimensions.
What the participant could or could not see during that recent use, including an explicit report that they could see clearly. Do not assume a problem or turn uncertainty into a problem.
What the participant did in response
What matters to the participant when choosing vehicle lights, in their own words; no ranked list or minimum number is required.
A stated practical obstacle to adding or using an extra vehicle light, including an explicit report of no obstacle. Do not suggest an installation, cost, or legal problem.
First reaction to the hypothetical extra vehicle light offered in different sizes, including uncertainty or insufficient information; no appearance or performance is shown or established.

Explicit response about the listed synthetic tiers: small_129, medium_279, large_499, none (explicitly considers none of these tiers), or not_sure (explicitly undecided). Missing, skipped, refused, or unrelated answers do not establish any price_fit. none does not by itself mean no product need; keep the participant's stated reason separately in price_reason.
The participant's stated reason for considering a listed size and price, considering none, or being unsure. Do not assume cost or lack of need is the reason.
The participant's desired first change to the hypothetical extra vehicle light, or an explicit statement that no change is needed or there is not enough information to judge.

anchors.label: Use context
anchors.objective: Understand the purpose of ordinary after-dark vehicle use. Retain volunteered vehicle details; clarify vehicle identity only if it changes fitment or interpretation. Do not require a model year, brand, or model merely to fill a field.
anchors.question: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?

questionLocales.en: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 你天黑后通常用车做什么？
questionLocales.es: ¿Para qué usas normalmente tu vehículo después de anochecer?

anchors.clarification: What do you use your vehicle to do after dark?

clarificationLocales.en: What do you use your vehicle to do after dark?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 我是想问，你通常为了做什么事情在天黑后用车？
clarificationLocales.es: ¿Para hacer qué usas tu vehículo después de anochecer?

sufficiencyCriteria: The purpose of after-dark vehicle use is understood, or the participant explicitly reports no such use or uncertainty.
Retain vehicle details when stated; missing vehicle identity alone is not a reason to demand more detail.
highValueProbeTargets: One missing trip or activity purpose, without asking simultaneously about roads, lighting, or weather.
Vehicle identity only when an actual fitment or interpretation question depends on it.

placeholder.en: Write your answer in your own words…

vehicle_year.en: What model year is your vehicle?
vehicle_year.zh-CN: 你的车是哪一款年份的车型？
vehicle_year.es: ¿De qué año de modelo es tu vehículo?

use_context.en: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?
use_context.zh-CN: 你天黑后通常用车做什么？
use_context.es: ¿Para qué usas normalmente tu vehículo después de anochecer?

anchors.label: Recent experience
anchors.objective: Understand what the participant could or could not see on their most recent after-dark vehicle use. Distinguish road type, available light, weather, and activity purpose. Ask only one missing dimension that affects understanding, using their own context; never ask a broad environment question or require all dimensions. Accept a short concrete answer and explicit absence of a visibility problem.
anchors.question: The last time you used your vehicle after dark, was anything difficult to see?

questionLocales.en: The last time you used your vehicle after dark, was anything difficult to see?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 最近一次天黑后用车时，有什么东西看不清吗？
questionLocales.es: La última vez que usaste tu vehículo de noche, ¿hubo algo que te costara ver?

anchors.clarification: Thinking of that last time, what could you not see clearly, if anything?

clarificationLocales.en: Thinking of that last time, what could you not see clearly, if anything?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 我是问最近那次夜间用车，有没有什么东西没看清？
clarificationLocales.es: Piensa en esa última vez: ¿hubo algo que no pudieras ver con claridad?

sufficiencyCriteria: The participant describes what was difficult to see, or explicitly reports no visibility problem or being unable to recall.
Preserve any stated context. A brief answer does not require a road, lighting, and weather checklist; missing context is probed only if it changes the interpretation.
highValueProbeTargets: One unclear object or task that was difficult to see, without assuming there was a problem.
One missing road type, available-light condition, or weather detail only when it explains a stated difficulty; never ask all three together.
The participant's response to a stated visibility problem, only if that action is still unknown.

placeholder.en: Describe what you could or could not see…
placeholder.es: Cuenta qué podías o no podías ver…

recent_location.en: What type of road were you on that time?
recent_location.zh-CN: 那次你开的是哪一类道路？
recent_location.es: ¿Por qué tipo de vía conducías esa vez?

visibility_problem.en: What could you not see clearly that time, if anything?
visibility_problem.zh-CN: 那次有什么东西没看清吗？
visibility_problem.es: ¿Hubo algo que no pudieras ver con claridad esa vez?

user_action.en: What did you do when you had trouble seeing?
user_action.zh-CN: 发现看不清时，你做了什么？

anchors.label: Priorities
anchors.objective: Understand what matters when the participant chooses vehicle lights. Ask openly without presenting the stored option labels as suggested answers. One stated priority is sufficient; no ranking or quota is required.
anchors.question: What matters most to you when choosing lights for your vehicle?

questionLocales.en: What matters most to you when choosing lights for your vehicle?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 给车选灯时，你最在意什么？
questionLocales.es: ¿Qué es lo que más te importa al elegir luces para tu vehículo?

anchors.clarification: What do you care about most when deciding which vehicle lights to use?

clarificationLocales.en: What do you care about most when deciding which vehicle lights to use?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 决定给车用哪款灯时，你最看重什么？
clarificationLocales.es: ¿Qué es lo que más te importa al decidir qué luces usar en tu vehículo?

sufficiencyCriteria: At least one priority is stated, or the participant explicitly has no preference or is unsure. Do not force a choice from the stored labels.
highValueProbeTargets: Clarify one unclear priority in the participant's own words only if it affects interpretation; do not force a tradeoff between compatible priorities.

priority.en: What matters most to you when choosing lights for your vehicle?
priority.zh-CN: 给车选灯时，你最在意什么？
priority.es: ¿Qué es lo que más te importa al elegir luces para tu vehículo?

anchors.label: Constraints
anchors.objective: Understand practical obstacles to adding or using a light beyond the vehicle's existing lights. Explain that object plainly; do not suggest obstacles or assume any exist. A report of no obstacle or uncertainty is valid.
anchors.question: What, if anything, would prevent you from adding an extra light to your vehicle or using it?

questionLocales.en: What, if anything, would prevent you from adding an extra light to your vehicle or using it?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 如果给车加装一盏灯，有什么事情会让你装不了或用不了吗？
questionLocales.es: ¿Hay algo que te impediría añadir una luz más a tu vehículo o usarla?

anchors.clarification: Thinking of a light added to the lights already on your vehicle, is there anything that would stop you from installing or using it?

clarificationLocales.en: Thinking of a light added to the lights already on your vehicle, is there anything that would stop you from installing or using it?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 这里说的是在车上现有的灯之外再加一盏灯，有什么会让你无法安装或使用吗？
clarificationLocales.es: Me refiero a una luz añadida a las que ya tiene tu vehículo: ¿hay algo que te impediría instalarla o usarla?

sufficiencyCriteria: A practical obstacle, explicit absence of obstacles, or explicit uncertainty is recorded without inventing a reason.
highValueProbeTargets: A concrete barrier that changes product requirements

placeholder.en: Write what would stop you, if anything…
placeholder.zh-CN: 按实际情况说，没有障碍也可以…
placeholder.es: Cuenta qué te lo impediría, si hay algo…

constraint.en: Thinking of a light added to the lights already on your vehicle, is there anything that would stop you from installing or using it?
constraint.zh-CN: 这里说的是在车上现有的灯之外再加一盏灯，有什么会让你无法安装或使用吗？
constraint.es: Me refiero a una luz añadida a las que ya tiene tu vehículo: ¿hay algo que te impediría instalarla o usarla?

anchors.label: Concept
anchors.objective: Introduce in plain text a hypothetical extra vehicle light offered in different sizes and capture a spontaneous reaction. Extra means in addition to existing vehicle lights. No image or performance information is provided: do not imply the participant has seen it, ask about appearance, or invent features. Uncertainty and insufficient information are valid reactions.
anchors.question: Imagine an extra light for your vehicle, offered in different sizes. What do you think of that idea?

questionLocales.en: Imagine an extra light for your vehicle, offered in different sizes. What do you think of that idea?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 设想给车加装一盏灯，有不同尺寸可选。你觉得这个想法怎么样？
questionLocales.es: Imagina una luz adicional para tu vehículo, disponible en varios tamaños. ¿Qué te parece esa idea?

anchors.clarification: The idea is a light added to your vehicle's existing lights, with different sizes to choose from. What is your first reaction?

clarificationLocales.en: The idea is a light added to your vehicle's existing lights, with different sizes to choose from. What is your first reaction?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 这个想法是在车上现有的灯之外再加一盏灯，有不同尺寸可选。你听到后的第一反应是什么？
clarificationLocales.es: La idea es añadir una luz a las que ya tiene tu vehículo, con distintos tamaños para elegir. ¿Cuál es tu primera reacción?

sufficiencyCriteria: A spontaneous reaction is recorded, including no interest, uncertainty, or insufficient information; do not require a benefit or concern.
highValueProbeTargets: A specific concern that changes the concept

concept_reaction.en: What do you think of the idea of an extra vehicle light with different sizes to choose from?
concept_reaction.zh-CN: 对于这种有不同尺寸可选的加装车灯，你有什么想法？
concept_reaction.es: ¿Qué te parece la idea de una luz adicional para el vehículo con varios tamaños para elegir?

anchors.label: Price
anchors.objective: Record a considered synthetic tier, an explicit decision to consider none of the tiers, or explicit uncertainty. Preserve the stated reason without inferring that rejecting these tiers always means no product need.
anchors.question: For this hypothetical extra vehicle light, the sample sizes and prices are 7–8 inches at US$129.99, 19–22 inches at US$279.99, and 48–52 inches at US$499.99. Which, if any, would you consider?

questionLocales.en: For this hypothetical extra vehicle light, the sample sizes and prices are 7–8 inches at US$129.99, 19–22 inches at US$279.99, and 48–52 inches at US$499.99. Which, if any, would you consider?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 这款假设的加装车灯有三组示例尺寸和价格：7–8 英寸为 129.99 美元，19–22 英寸为 279.99 美元，48–52 英寸为 499.99 美元。你会考虑其中哪一组吗？
questionLocales.es: Para esta luz adicional hipotética, los tamaños y precios de ejemplo son 7–8 pulgadas por US$129.99, 19–22 pulgadas por US$279.99 y 48–52 pulgadas por US$499.99. ¿Considerarías alguna de estas opciones?

anchors.clarification: These are example size and price combinations for the hypothetical extra light. Is there one you would consider?

clarificationLocales.en: These are example size and price combinations for the hypothetical extra light. Is there one you would consider?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 这里问的是刚才列出的加装车灯尺寸和价格组合，有哪一组是你会考虑的吗？
clarificationLocales.es: Son combinaciones de tamaño y precio de ejemplo para la luz adicional hipotética. ¿Hay alguna que considerarías?

sufficiencyCriteria: Record the declared option ID matching the explicit answer: small_129, medium_279, large_499, none, or not_sure.

Explicitly considering no listed tier is none; explicitly being undecided is not_sure. Neither requires choosing a price tier. A missing, skipped, refused, or unrelated answer is not none or not_sure.
Keep any stated reason in price_reason; do not invent no purchase need, a budget problem, or a selected tier.
highValueProbeTargets: One reason for the participant's actual answer, whether a considered option, none, or uncertainty; do not assume a purchase need or cost objection.

price_fit.en: For this hypothetical extra vehicle light, the sample sizes and prices are 7–8 inches at US$129.99, 19–22 inches at US$279.99, and 48–52 inches at US$499.99. Which, if any, would you consider?
price_fit.zh-CN: 这款假设的加装车灯有三组示例尺寸和价格：7–8 英寸为 129.99 美元，19–22 英寸为 279.99 美元，48–52 英寸为 499.99 美元。你会考虑其中哪一组吗？
price_fit.es: Para esta luz adicional hipotética, los tamaños y precios de ejemplo son 7–8 pulgadas por US$129.99, 19–22 pulgadas por US$279.99 y 48–52 pulgadas por US$499.99. ¿Considerarías alguna de estas opciones?

price_reason.en: What led you to that answer about the listed sizes and prices?
price_reason.zh-CN: 对于刚才列出的尺寸和价格，你这样回答的原因是什么？
price_reason.es: ¿Qué te llevó a responder así sobre los tamaños y precios indicados?

anchors.label: Final change
anchors.objective: Understand whether the participant wants anything changed about the hypothetical extra vehicle light just discussed, and their first change if any. Keep the referent explicit. No change, uncertainty, and insufficient information are valid; never force a criticism or new detail.
anchors.question: What, if anything, would you change first about the extra vehicle light we just discussed?

questionLocales.en: What, if anything, would you change first about the extra vehicle light we just discussed?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 对于刚才讨论的加装车灯，有没有你最想先改的地方？
questionLocales.es: ¿Qué cambiarías primero, si cambiarías algo, de la luz adicional para el vehículo que acabamos de comentar?

anchors.clarification: Thinking only of the extra vehicle light we discussed, is there anything you would want changed?

clarificationLocales.en: Thinking only of the extra vehicle light we discussed, is there anything you would want changed?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 我是问刚才讨论的那款加装车灯，有没有你希望改动的地方？
clarificationLocales.es: Pensando en la luz adicional que comentamos, ¿hay algo que quisieras cambiar?

sufficiencyCriteria: Record a desired first change, no desired change, uncertainty, or insufficient information. Do not require an invented improvement.
highValueProbeTargets: Clarify the object of one proposed change only if unclear; do not demand alternatives or a ranking.

placeholder.en: Share a change you want, if any…
placeholder.zh-CN: 说说有没有想改的地方…
placeholder.es: Escribe qué cambiarías, si cambiarías algo…

final_change.en: What, if anything, would you change first about the extra vehicle light we just discussed?
final_change.zh-CN: 对于刚才讨论的加装车灯，有没有你最想先改的地方？
final_change.es: ¿Qué cambiarías primero, si cambiarías algo, de la luz adicional para el vehículo que acabamos de comentar?

messages.en: Your synthetic interview record is complete. No reward or follow-up is attached to this fixture.
messages.zh-CN: 这次模拟访谈已经完成，不会触发奖励或后续联系。
messages.es: Tu registro sintético está completo. Esta prueba no incluye recompensa ni seguimiento.

analysis.primaryDecisionQuestion: Which use situations and visibility problems deserve further real-user study?
